label: P1GCCB passive 10/100/1000 copper breakout TAP
description: Passive inline breakout tap for a 10/100/1000BASE-T copper link: two RJ45 network ports stay mated to the live link and two RJ45 monitor ports hand a full-duplex copy to the tool. Unpowered and failsafe, with no IP stack - PoE passes through to the powered device.
